SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
The BoomTone DJ LightShow-BAT is a portable light show that's perfect for creating dynamic, colourful atmospheres with ease. Compact and lightweight, it combines multicolour effects, stroboscope and beams of light to liven up your parties, private events or small stages. It runs on an integrated lithium battery for 3 to 4 hours, making it ideal for quick installations with no electrical constraints. You can control it remotely using an infrared remote control, or let its effects automatically follow the beat of your music using the sound detection mode. The LightShow-BAT features 3 x 3 W RGB LEDs to create projections in a variety of colours and a stroboscope effect powered by 2 x 1 W LEDs. This set of lights provides a wide range of visual effects to liven up your events and highlight your space. Its robust plastic casing and light weight of 0.5 kg make it easy to transport and install on any type of site, be it a stage, dance floor or reception hall. Designed for mobile DJs, entertainers and event organisers, BoomToneDJ's LightShow-BAT is an affordable solution for enhancing your lighting ambience while enjoying great freedom of use.

Thanks to their adjustable height from 660 to 1160 mm, they can be easily adapted to all listening configurations, whether you're in a studio or a living room. Each stand has a 230 x 230 mm platform, perfect for most compact or medium-sized speakers. The steel structure, combined with a 450 mm triangular base, guarantees maximum stability, even at high heights. To improve sound reproduction, the MS2 stands are fitted with decoupling spikes, limiting the transmission of vibrations to the floor. With their sober, elegant black finish, they look equally at home in a modern studio or domestic listening space. Each stand weighs 4.8 kg and can support up to 18 kg, making it a robust and versatile solution for enhancing your listening environment with efficiency and style.

SHOPITEM.DESCRIPTION:
The Divarte ST Electric Black electric guitar pack has everything you need to get off to a good start. The 4/4-size guitar features an ST-style body in lightweight paulownia and a C-profile maple neck with 22-fret rosewood fingerboard. The positions are comfortable, the bends are easy to place and the grip helps you progress without tiring. The three single-coil pickups deliver clean tones for funk and pop, and more responsive tones for rock and blues. The 5-position selector switch lets you switch from a round neck sound to a more incisive bridge sound, while the chromed vibrato allows for controlled effects. The oil-bath action stabilises the tuning for repeated playing sessions. The Divarte GA-20 amp develops 20 watts, enough for playing at home or in small rehearsals. Gain, Drive, Volume controls and a 2-band Bass/Treble EQ help you understand how to shape a clean, crunchy or more saturated sound. Auxiliary mini-jack input for launching playbacks, headphone output for practising in silence. The pack also includes a clip-on tuner, strap, cover, picks, vibrato bar, cable, tuning spanner and spare set of strings, so you can concentrate on learning and enjoying your playing.

Plugger, a French brand specialising in audio equipment, puts its technical know-how at the service of professionals, with pre- and post-purchase support from France. Plugger Case is a French brand, most of the products in its catalog are dedicated to the needs of DJs, event organizers and musical entertainment professionals. Plugger Case products from the QuickStage range are modular, allowing you to create a wide variety of raised surfaces in just a few minutes, from a simple podium for a speech, to a fashion show path winding through a large room, including a stage concert for a group of musicians or a podium for DJ. The QuickStage 6 Set is made up of 6 platforms of one square meter, 20mm thick, supplied in their custom-made transport flight case. Coated with a non-slip surface, they are designed for indoor or outdoor use.
